    The subcategories C_J are defined by their labels #

    C_J is the isomorphism closure of the objects of C(D) all of whose labels have their index in J. The labels of an object are invariant under isomorphism in the following weak sense, which is all we need: if M ≅ N and every label of N lies in J, then so does every label of M. Indeed ρN is E-good for the finite set E of indices of N, hence so is ρM, hence so is each interval summand of ρM, and a good interval has its index in E. So C_J is exactly the full subcategory of objects with all labels in J.
